description: Illustrative rule set. Not an industry-standard methodology and not empirically calibrated. See docs/risk-model.md.

escalation_rules.description: Restricted data with read_write or admin permissions
escalation_rules.required_output: A written finding on whether this integration can change or administer restricted data, which limits apply to that access, and whether the exposure is to be reduced, accepted for a stated period, or stopped.
escalation_rules.next_step: Record the finding on the risk register, with a remediation action when access must change. Escalated review continues until a person records that outcome.

escalation_rules.description: Autonomous AI with confidential or restricted data
escalation_rules.required_output: An impact assessment of the autonomous behavior, the confidential or restricted data it can reach, who or what is affected, and the human oversight that can interrupt it.
escalation_rules.next_step: Keep the engagement on escalated review until the AI governance reviewer records the assessment outcome and any remediation that outcome requires.

escalation_rules.required_output: One resolved evidence status for the conflicting claim, naming the source relied on and why the contradicting source was rejected or superseded.
escalation_rules.next_step: Update the claim or the evidence record, then re-run the assessment. The conflict remains until a reviewer resolves it.

escalation_rules.description: AI in use with confidential or restricted data, and model training is yes or unknown
escalation_rules.required_output: A determination of whether customer or organizational data is used to train or improve a model, which data elements are involved, and the contractual or technical limit that supports the answer.
escalation_rules.next_step: When training is confirmed, record a risk and a remediation action. When training is shown not to occur, re-run the assessment with model training set to no. An unknown answer is not treated as no.

escalation_rules.required_output: The data categories in scope and one confirmed sensitivity value: public, internal, confidential, or restricted.
escalation_rules.next_step: Re-run the assessment with that value before opening any further deeper assessment. The provisional score is not a completed review.

escalation_rules.description: Confidential or restricted data, and retention and deletion is undocumented or unknown
escalation_rules.required_output: The retention period, the deletion method, and where that practice is documented, or a finding that the practice is not documented.
escalation_rules.next_step: When the practice is undocumented, record a remediation action to document or change it. When it is documented, re-run the assessment with retention and deletion set to documented.

escalation_rules.description: Integration permissions are unknown and data sensitivity is confidential or restricted
escalation_rules.required_output: The effective permission level taken from the integration configuration: none, read_only, read_write, or admin.
escalation_rules.next_step: Re-run the assessment with the confirmed permission level. Restricted data with read_write or admin access then follows the privileged-access impact assessment.

escalation_rules.description: AI use is unknown and data sensitivity is confidential or restricted
escalation_rules.required_output: Whether the service uses no AI, assistive AI, or autonomous AI, and whether a model is trained on customer data.
escalation_rules.next_step: Re-run the assessment. Autonomous use follows the AI impact assessment. Assistive or autonomous use with training set to yes or unknown follows the model-training assessment. Confirmed absence of AI does not open either assessment.
